number.why: HR 0.60 (0.37-0.97) is the FREEDOM hip-fracture estimate, denosumab vs placebo, 95% CI, full analysis set, 36 months. It is not the nonvertebral HR 0.80 in the next sentence.

quotes.span: Denosumab reduced the risk of hip fracture, with a cumulative incidence of 0.7% in the denosumab group, versus 1.2% in the placebo group (hazard ratio, 0.60; 95% CI, 0.37 to 0.97; P=0.04)

missed: The outcome declares RR while an HR is served, and the counts are available: RR = (26/3902)/(43/3906) = 0.605, essentially equal to the HR. This is the same inconsistency with M-02 as in M-03. The typed analysis_set reading here is OTHER_SET_STATED, but M-03 has ITT_STATED for the same registry 'Full analysis set' wording.
